verdict.rationale: This is a skill pack that runs inside host coding agents, so AI-generated insights come from the user's repo and issues rather than from a standalone product. Documented skills produce suggestions from that data: a visual report of modules worth refactoring, diff review against standards and spec, cited answers from primary sources, recommended answers during grilling, and triage that categorises and verifies issues. Missing for 10: a native in-product insights surface independent of a host agent, insights over non-code business data, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the insight-producing skills (e.g., the refactor report) work as described.
